preview.title: Relay — first deploy
preview.body: Create a project, turn on auto-publish, and ship it — in the product itself.

steps.title: Start a project
steps.body: Relay opens on the team's {**Overview**}. Nothing is deployed yet — hit **New project** to begin.

steps.title: Give it a name
steps.body: The name becomes the project's subdomain, so it has to be URL-safe. Type anything you like — [or leave the placeholder].

steps.title: Create it
steps.body: Relay provisions the project and drops you back on the Overview with a {**Preview**} build already running.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Your new project is in the list. Next, the one setting worth changing on day one — find it under **Settings**.

steps.title: Auto-publish previews
steps.body: With this on, a preview that passes its checks is promoted straight to production. Turn it on.

steps.title: Save the change
steps.body: Settings don't apply until they're saved — that's deliberate, so a half-finished change never ships.
